oriented expression that translates to “past times,” and coded each speaker’s manual gestures.

imagined linear axes: for instance, Spanish speakers often refer to the left/right axis to describe
events in time. Some researchers believe this tendency is universal, but Núñez and colleagues
claim this is not the case.
